title: Winspace G3 Gravel Frame | Unboxing

takeaways.text: UK dealer unboxing of a size 54: aero seatpost, FSA ACR-compatible headset, UDH, T47, drop chainstay and Winspace's 50 mm clearance claim; the dealer says owners have fitted Schwalbe Thunder Burt MTB tires.
Winspace frames and complete bikes arrive unassembled (fork not fitted, steerer uncut, hoses not connected), so this dealer builds complete bikes before shipping.
Paint and finish looked good, the bottom-bracket faces were cleaned on both sides with no overspray, and the fork has fender mounts.

disclosure: Published by a UK retailer that sells the frameset and links its product page.
summary: Retailer unboxing of a G3 frameset in Grape Soda showing what arrives in the box. Retailer material, not an independent review.
